_doc: Task 6K section 13. Cross-analysis of the frozen Task 6J J1 result against source-side evidence (raw semantic component size, distance to the <50 threshold, border status, merge-risk class, proposal count, RAW-vs-CONVERTED relation drift). Attribution is made only where the evidence supports it.

medium_merge_risk_base_rate.note: The merge-risk MEDIUM class fires for most tiles in both outcomes, so it is recorded but deliberately NOT used as conversion-related evidence.

evidence_notes.conversion_rule: conversion/data-related when the target would be deleted by the <50 filter, has no raw counterpart, is HIGH merge risk, or its RAW-vs-CONVERTED target actually changed
evidence_notes.inseparable: otherwise (no clean proposal and no conversion flag)
evidence_notes.proposal_rule: proposal-model-related when no conversion flag holds and the target HAS a proposal at IoU >= 0.5
evidence_notes.raw_vs_converted_status: the tile's relation drift status for this query type (section 9)
evidence_notes.target_merge_risk: heuristic merge-risk class of the raw target component (section 12)
evidence_notes.target_raw_area_minus_50: how far the raw target area sits from the historical `<50` contourArea threshold
evidence_notes.target_raw_area_px: raster area of the raw 8-connected semantic component matching the target (IoU >= 0.5)

current_dataset_facts.instruction_families: finite templated families generated from reasoning_steps
current_dataset_facts.template_variants_per_family: at least 3 in the current generator

does_not_prove: 2B is sufficient for arbitrary natural language;
qwen_qualification.proves: Task 6J proves Qwen3-VL-2B is sufficient for the current closed-template 20-program classification task.
